message: I’ve always found storms to be a bit dramatic, don’t you think? Just when you’re cozying up with a cup of tea, the power decides to play hide and seek. That’s why I appreciate having a reliable resource on hand for thunderstorms and lightning. It’s a good reminder to have a plan in place—especially when our phones and gadgets might not be so reliable when we need them most. Just a little prep can keep the calm in the chaos. 🌩️
